en: A vintage black‑and‑white panoramic view over a town with many church spires rising above tightly packed roofs. In the foreground there is a formal garden or park with geometric planting beds and a stone wall, lined with trees and paths. The caption printed at the bottom identifies the scene as a panorama from Münzenberg in Quedlinburg, and the publisher details and date are also printed.
